item.title: SNAPPED: Powder hounds make the most of winter, vol. II
item.description: JACKSON, Wyo. — With barely any valley snow to speak of, opportunities for canine snow shenanigans have been different in recent weeks. Still, local dog owners shared their joy-inducing snapshots of their powder hounds enjoying the outdoors this winter.
